records.surface: project header › Undo refusal › View details
records.state: Legacy attic restored from Archive, then header Undo
evidence: dialog text: "Legacy shelving [project-legacy-child]: Restore or move the new dependent, then try Undo again."
records.expected: The reason names what blocks the Undo: Legacy shelving inside the attic is live, so the attic cannot go back to archived.
records.actual: The detail tells the user to "Restore or move the new dependent" about a workstream that was always there and is live: "Restore" does not apply and "new" is wrong.
records.heuristic: Nielsen #9 Help users recognize, diagnose and recover from errors

records.surface: Markdown section › edit › Preview
records.state: typed draft, Cancel, Edit, Discard draft, Preview
evidence: Preview after Discard draft: "Unsaved preview" over "Appliances and finishes before cabinets are ordered." (the saved text)
repro: 2. Markdown: Edit, type " DRAFT", Preview, Cancel
3. Edit ("Your unsaved draft is back."), Discard draft
records.expected: With the draft discarded, Preview shows the saved text without an unsaved label.
records.actual: Preview still says "Unsaved preview" over the saved text, with nothing unsaved.

records.decisionReopened: Feedback is one toast with receipt-specific Undo
records.surface: restore toast (project Archive vs Settings › Archived projects)
records.state: Legacy attic restored as Active from each place
evidence: Archive: "Restored Legacy attic as Active." with Go to it, Undo, Dismiss; Settings: the same sentence with Open it, Dismiss and no Undo; focus lands on Go to it / Open it
records.expected: One restore gives one feedback: the same link name and the same Undo wherever it starts.
records.actual: Archive offers "Go to it" and Undo; Settings offers "Open it" and no Undo, for the same restore.

records.surface: Todos page of an archived root
records.state: Home renovation archived with its three workstreams (MCP archive_project)
evidence: main text: "Everything under this project, in due-date order. Open a row to work on it where it lives." then "Restore to view 12 hidden todos."
repro: 1. seed nested-projects; archive project-renovation with Kitchen, Cabinets, Garden (MCP, c82-mcp.mjs)
records.expected: An archived root's Todos says why nothing is listed and how to bring it back, without an instruction to open rows that are not there.
records.actual: The intro "Open a row to work on it where it lives." sits over "Restore to view 12 hidden todos.", with no rows.
records.heuristic: Nielsen #2 Match between system and the real world

records.surface: project header history after a failed write

evidence: script apps/e2e/ux/walk/repro/c82-item06-unreachable-write.js: during, history buttons "History unavailable", "History unavailable", "Retry"; 4 s after the network returns, the same three
repro: 2. node apps/e2e/ux/walk/walk.mjs 5320 run -f apps/e2e/ux/walk/repro/c82-item06-unreachable-write.js (adds a task on Kitchen while /api writes and history reads are refused; route.fallback() for the rest)
3. read the header history before and after the route is lifted
records.expected: Once the workspace answers again, the history re-reads itself (or says how), so Undo of the next write is available.
records.actual: The header keeps "History unavailable" and a bare Retry after the workspace is reachable; nothing re-reads until Retry is pressed.
records.heuristic: Nielsen #9 Help users recover from errors
